text: Hey, everybody. Dan McClellan here. Welcome to my  YouTube channel, which is still very much under   construction. We hope to have some content up in  the coming days and weeks that will be examining
the academic study of the Bible and of religion,  and primarily through the methodological lenses   of my own specializations in biblical studies,  in cognitive linguistics, and in the cognitive
science of religion. I hope you will subscribe  so you can stay up-to-date on that content.   I hope you will let my know in the comments  what kinds of things you would like to see,
and when we do have some content up, I hope  you will find things that are entertaining,   that are uplifting, that are educational,  and I hope you have a wonderful day.
